title: The PRISM Alignment Dataset: What Participatory, Representative and Individualised Human Feedback Reveals About the Subjective and Multicultural Alignment of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Hannah Rose Kirk、Alexander Whitefield、Paul Röttger 等
paper_type_zh: 参与式、多文化人类反馈数据集与对齐审计研究
best_for_zh: 研究偏好多元性、代表性采样、个性化对齐或人类反馈治理的读者
one_line: PRISM links 1,500 participants’ stated preferences and profiles to fine-grained ratings in 8,011 live conversations with 21 LLMs.
PRISM 将 1,500 名参与者的调查、社会人口信息与 21 个 LLM 的实时对话评分相连，揭示多文化对齐的主观差异。
why: It makes the question of which humans provide alignment data empirically auditable rather than collapsing disagreement into one reward.
inclusion_reason: Public participatory human-feedback data that preserves demographic, cultural, and individual variation in alignment judgments.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Alignment often treats feedback as a universal target, even though value-laden judgments differ across people and cultures. Convenience samples and anonymous aggregates make it difficult to separate disagreement from participant composition.

PRISM links survey profiles, stated preferences, live conversations, cardinal ratings, and fine-grained feedback. It supports participatory global, UK/US representative, and individualized analyses. It is pluralistic feedback data, not a license to infer identities or reduce variation to one reward.

对齐常把反馈当普遍目标，但价值性判断会因人和文化而异。便利样本和匿名汇总难以区分真正分歧与参与者构成。

PRISM 连接调查档案、已陈述偏好、实时对话、基数评分和细粒度反馈，支持参与式全球、英国/美国代表性及个体化分析。它是多元反馈数据，而不是推断身份或压缩差异为单一奖励的许可证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
PRISM records who provides what judgment in live interaction. Participants survey first, choose a conversation type, rate responses from 1 to 100, and give fine-grained feedback. Its contract preserves individual context under usage restrictions. Unlike aggregate leaderboards, it enables representative and individualized analyses. The direction is to treat sampling and disagreement as alignment data, not annotation noise.

Official data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HannahRoseKirk/prism-alignment. Code: https://github.com/HannahKirk/prism-alignment.

PRISM 记录谁在实时互动中提供何种判断。参与者先调查，再选对话类型，对回答按 1–100 评分并给出细粒度反馈。其契约在使用限制下保留个体语境。不同于平均排行榜，它支持代表性和个体化分析。其方向是将采样和分歧视为对齐数据，而非标注噪声。

官方数据：https://huggingface.co/datasets/HannahRoseKirk/prism-alignment。代码：https://github.com/HannahKirk/prism-alignment。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Survey 1,500 participants about demographics, LLM familiarity, self-description, and stated preferences.
  2. Participants choose unguided, values-guided, or controversy-guided dialogue and write an opening prompt.
  3. Four of 21 LLMs answer the first turn; participant rates 1–100 and the highest-rated model continues.
  4. Later, the same model creates A/B responses at non-deterministic temperature; participants rate and explain.
  5. Release survey, conversation, utterance, and metadata JSONL with privacy flags. Reuse needs terms compliance, no re-identification, and conversation-level splits.

1. 调查 1,500 名参与者的人口信息、LLM 熟悉度、自我描述和已陈述偏好。
  2. 参与者选择无引导、价值引导或争议引导对话并写开场提示。
  3. 21 个 LLM 中的四个回答首轮；参与者按 1–100 评分，最高分模型继续。
  4. 后续同一模型以非确定温度生成 A/B 回答；参与者评分并解释。
  5. 发布含隐私标记的 survey、conversation、utterance、metadata JSONL。复用需遵守条款、不重识别并按对话切分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
PRISM links 1,500 participants born in 75 countries to 8,011 conversation trees with 21 LLMs and 68,371 scored utterances. Of surveyed participants, 1,396 reach the conversation stage.

UK and US samples support census-representative analyses, while profiles permit attribution of sampling artifacts. Case studies show conclusions depend on who provides feedback. This supports pluralistic evaluation, not causal claims about a demographic field.

PRISM 将来自 75 国的 1,500 名参与者连接到 21 个 LLM 的 8,011 棵对话树和 68,371 条评分话语；1,396 名调查参与者进入对话阶段。

英国和美国样本支持人口普查代表性分析，档案可归因采样伪影。案例研究表明结论取决于谁提供反馈。这支持多元评估，而非关于人口字段的因果主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Most feedback datasets release choices without the rater context needed to analyze heterogeneity. PRISM changes the record by linking live multi-turn ratings with survey, geographic, demographic, and stated-preference context. The direction signal is participatory and representative alignment measurement. The scale, ethics approval, data statement, and release of metadata are quality signals. It is not a global census and linked profiles do not justify individual targeting.
多数反馈数据发布选择却没有分析异质性所需的评分者语境。PRISM 将实时多轮评分与调查、地理、人口和已陈述偏好相连。其方向信号是参与式且具有代表性的对齐测量。规模、伦理批准、数据声明和元数据发布是质量信号；它不是全球普查，关联档案也不构成针对个人的理由。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Participants and conversations are mostly English, so geographic diversity does not equal linguistic or cultural coverage. Report population scope and do not generalize to unrepresented communities.

Linked profile and conversation data increase re-identification risk. Follow no-deanonymisation terms, avoid sensitive trait inference, and use privacy flags before analysis.

Model responses have provider-specific terms and CC-BY-NC licensing. Check model licenses and filter unsafe raw conversations before training or redistribution.

参与者和对话主要为英语，地理多样性不等于语言或文化覆盖。应报告人群范围，不把分数泛化到未代表社群。

关联档案和对话增加重识别风险。应遵守禁止去匿名条款、避免推断敏感特征，并在分析前使用隐私标记。

模型回答有提供商特异条款和 CC-BY-NC 许可。训练或再分发前需检查模型许可并过滤不安全原始对话。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use PRISM to audit whether an alignment conclusion changes across participatory, representative, or individual feedback. Input is survey-linked conversation and rating data; actions include subgroup-aware evaluation and disagreement analysis. Success reports uncertainty, population scope, and privacy safeguards.

Do not re-identify people, infer sensitive traits for deployment, or call one aggregate score a universal cultural target.

可用 PRISM 审计对齐结论在参与式、代表性或个体化反馈下是否改变。输入是关联调查的对话和评分；可做分组评估和分歧分析。成功应报告不确定性、人群范围和隐私保障。

不应重识别个人、为部署推断敏感特征，或把一个平均分称为普遍文化目标。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep ratings linked to sampling and conversation context.
  2. Separate participatory, representative, and individual claims.
  3. Pin HF revision; inspect survey, conversation, utterance, metadata.
  4. Enforce no-deanonymisation and provider terms.
  5. Report disagreement and uncertainty, not only average winner.

1. 将评分与采样和对话语境关联。
  2. 区分参与式、代表性和个体结论。
  3. 固定 HF 版本，检查调查、对话、话语、元数据。
  4. 执行禁止去匿名和提供商条款。
  5. 报告分歧和不确定性，而非只报平均胜者。
